reviews.text: I have Stiff person syndrome and regular alarms are too sudden, setting off and episode, but this app is perfect for a gentle wakeup.

Beware, this app also includes Facebook Ads and location tracking, both enabled by default. why does a sleep app need GPS tracking?? I found these settings buried in privacy settings. For me, this is a turnoff... health data and Facebook advertising dont work for me
reviews.reply: Hello, the app needs fine location only for enabling BT for watch tracking (BT cannot be used without fine location permission on Android). The coarse location (± 5 km) is used for Not-at-home CAPTCHA and for geotagging the graphs. All three are optional and will only be active if you grant the permission. Ads are only in the free version.

reviews.text: I've been using the free version for a few years now, and decided to buy the full version. However, what I love about this app is the free version is still a great alarm app. It doesn't force you to use the dashboard view showing all the features you have to pay to use, you can just set it to show your alarms and that's basically it. It's as simple or as complicated as you want it to be, and you don't have to open your wallet to eliminate any reminders of features you don't want or need.

the only sleep tracker out of the 5 that I have tried, that actually tracks my light sleep and awake phases accurately. I was so impressed that I paid the one off subscription fee (you read that right folks, just once!) Other apps I could PICK UP MY PHONE AND USE IT and they would still log me asleep. Definitely recommend!

reviews.text: The QR code scanning is the only thing getting me out of bed

This app has helped me sleep so well and here's reasons why, First off, it has a sleep tracker so I can see how I've been sleeping, what noises I make during sleeping and how much I slept with the quality of how I slept. Secondly, there's an alarm to wake you up and it's much more effective than the usual alarm on my device. When I get up, it puts me to the test to see if I am not half-asleep or slacking/being lazy. Last but not least, the Improving section, it tells me what I can improve on.

My sleep has been okay, for the second night after installation. Getting it started has been difficult on both nights. *Sunday night: I played music in addition to the app, and that's all the app recorded. *Monday night: I played the same music through the app as a lullaby. The volume constantly went up high, even after I turned it down. I turned the music off due the disruption. I'd set up meditation to play with the music, but it didn't play. This caused no relaxation. I hope it improves.
